  PLAN "Nutrition for Glycaemic Control with Calorie Guidance":
    PRINCIPLES:
      - "Prioritise regular protein at each meal (~25-30g) to support muscle and glycaemic stability"
      - "Distribute carbohydrates across the day; favour low-glycaemic-index choices"
      - "Include fibre-rich vegetables and whole grains to slow glucose absorption"
      - "Pair carbs with protein and healthy fats to blunt post-meal glucose spikes"
      - "Avoid long fasting and monitor energy: ensure adequate calories to prevent under-fuelling"
      - "Prefer minimally processed foods; limit sugary drinks and refined carbs"
      - "Hydration and sleep hygiene support metabolic health"
    DAILY_STRUCTURE:
      - "3 main meals + 1-2 snacks depending on appetite and training days"
      - "Pre-workout: small snack with carbs + protein 60-90 minutes before training (e.g. yogurt + berries)"
      - "Post-workout: protein-focused meal within 2 hours (e.g. chicken + vegetables + moderate carbs)"
    SAMPLE_DAY_LOW_CALORIE (for lighter days / rest days):
      - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt (protein) with chia seed and small portion of oats + berries"
      - "Lunch: Salad with mixed vegetables, chickpeas or lentils, olive oil, and grilled fish"
      - "Snack: Handful of nuts and an apple"
      - "Dinner: Baked salmon, steamed broccoli, and small sweet potato"
    SAMPLE_DAY_TRAINING (for lifting + HIIT days):
      - "Breakfast: Omelette with vegetables + wholegrain toast"
      - "Pre-workout snack: Banana with cottage cheese or a small protein shake"
      - "Post-workout lunch: Quinoa or brown rice, chicken breast, mixed vegetables"
      - "Snack: Carrot sticks with hummus"
      - "Dinner: Stir-fry with tofu, plenty of vegetables, and a moderate portion of brown rice"
    MACROS_GUIDE:
      - "Protein: target ~1.6..1.8 g/kg bodyweight per day while in higher intensity phase to preserve lean mass"
      - "Carbohydrate: moderate and timed around training; avoid very-low-carb on heavy training days"
      - "Fat: include healthy fats (olive oil, nuts, avocado) making up remaining calories"
    CALORIE_STRATEGY:
      - "Aggressive deficit increases risk of under-fuelling, menstrual disturbance and worsened metabolic health in PCOS; if pursuing larger deficit, follow these safeguards:"
      - "Start with a conservative deficit (≈10-15%) for 2 weeks and monitor energy, sleep, mood, training performance, and menstrual changes"
      - "If tolerating well, progress to a larger deficit (≈20% max) but avoid >20% without medical supervision"
      - "On heavy lifting or HIIT days, allow a higher intake (refeed) — add ~200-300 kcal with extra carbs and protein to support performance and recovery"
      - "Ensure minimum daily protein target and distribute it evenly across meals"
    MONITORING_AND_SAFETY:
      - "We will check symptoms weekly (energy, sleep, hunger, training performance) and schedule nutrition reviews at week 2, 4, and 8"
      - "If dizziness, syncope, big drops in performance, worsening menstrual irregularity, or HbA1c deterioration occur, increase calories and consult endocrine team"
      - "Avoid prolonged very-low-calorie diets (<1200 kcal/day) unless supervised by clinician"
    BEHAVIOUR_STRATEGIES:
      - "Prioritise nutrient-dense foods; use small, sustainable steps rather than drastic restrictive rules"
      - "Plan refeed meals on the busiest training days to support adherence and recovery"
    RESOURCES:
      - "Examples: lean meats, eggs, dairy or alternatives, legumes, whole grains, vegetables, fruits (portion-controlled), nuts and seeds, olive oil"
      - "Limit: sugary beverages, pastries, high-glycaemic snack foods"
